findings.problem: Build-time assertions compare floats with exact or 1e-9 tolerance (tile fire times vs KEYS, head(at) vs the fired step); an author saw an intermittent failure printing equal-looking numbers. Not reproduced in 8 page loads, but the checks are fragile.
findings.fix: Compare integer steps with Math.round and times with a 1e-6 tolerance; compare the fired steps as a joined string.

findings.problem: At the start one dot (bottom, x about 4) sits half hidden behind the grey 'extra: w = 0.6' tag; the dots are drawn under the tags.
findings.fix: Put the w tag and the step tag inside the map element, under the dot layer, so dots always show on top.

findings.problem: By steps 9-12 the 1.5-step tails of 14 particles form a dense tangle round the food and hide the gathering.
findings.fix: Shorten the tails to 0.8 steps and fade them to 0.3 during the fast phase.

findings.problem: The velocity formula v + c1 z1 (p - x) + c2 z2 (g - x) is never shown in symbols anywhere; the arrows are labelled only +3 and -2, so a learner cannot tie the numbers to c1, z1, p and x.
findings.fix: Label the purple and orange arrows 'c₁z₁(p − x) = +3' and 'c₂z₂(g − x) = −2' (labels on the free left side of each lane).

findings.problem: Part A (1 + 0.7 = ?) is a small strip at the top of the stage for 3 s; the lower two thirds are empty.
findings.fix: Draw part A larger (chips 124 to 156 px wide, 110 high, 58 px text) and centred vertically.

findings.problem: Caption '3, 5 plus 2, minus 1 lands on 5, 4.' reads as arithmetic (2 minus 1) rather than two vectors.
findings.fix: Write the vectors in brackets: '(3, 5) plus (2, −1) lands on (5, 4).'

findings.problem: Same map as scene 4 but the purple ring and orange star lose their 'p' and 'g' letters.
findings.fix: Add the same p and g letters as scene 4.

findings.problem: Velocity arrows (0.2-0.5 units, 12-30 px) mostly sit under the 13 px dots; only the heads poke out.
findings.fix: None: the spec asks for true-size arrows and the heads read; scenes 3 and 4 show velocity large.

findings.problem: After the arrow fades, the z tags still show the 20th roll's dice, which no arrow points to.
findings.fix: None needed: the dice panel shows the last roll, as a die would.

findings.problem: All numbers checked against L12 asserts and lesson sources (pso-01 RULES, pso-02 premature convergence, pso-03 stopFig w 0.6 extra, pso-workshop rand() < v): no disagreement found.
Brand grep clean (no white, gradients, blur, filters, Math.random, timers); determinism: 5 frames rendered in two orders have identical md5; info total 122 s, no page errors.
